notes.title: The Moving Simulator demo is now publicly available
notes.notes:
[p]We’re excited to announce that the demo for Moving Simulator is now live and ready for you to play.[/p][p]Step into the shoes of a professional mover - pack up belongings, disassemble furniture, load everything into the truck, and make sure it all arrives in one piece.[/p][p]Try the demo today and see if you’ve got what it takes to handle the chaos of moving day.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts, so feel free to share your feedback in the community discussions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]Corpix Games
[/p]

notes.title: Sign Up for the Moving Simulator Playtests!
notes.notes:
Experience what it's like to move professionally – before anyone else does!

Hey gamers!

We’re excited to announce that Moving Simulator is getting ready for its first public playtests, and you can be one of the first to try it out!

You can now sign up for the playtests and help us improve the game. We’re looking for players who:

✅ Enjoy simulators with humor and realism
✅ Want to help us test and share feedback
✅ Aren’t afraid to carry (virtual) boxes 📦

Just click the “Request Access” button on the game’s Steam page. Selected players will receive access soon.

Thanks for your support – and see you on the move!
The Moving Simulator Team

notes.title: Welcome to Moving Simulator!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a unique and satisfying experience – Moving Simulator is coming soon!

In Moving Simulator, you'll take on the challenge of managing house moves for a variety of clients. Carefully pack boxes, transport fragile items, organize loading, and make sure everything arrives safely at its new home. Every move is a different story – from tiny apartments to huge family houses – and only the most efficient movers will succeed!

If you enjoy games about organizing, logistics, and a little bit of chaos, Moving Simulator will be right up your alley.

Don't miss out – add Moving Simulator to your wishlist now and be the first to know when it launches! 

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to share more with you soon!
